summary: A Ten Ton Hammer news post, based on an SOE press release, announcing a 'Super Secret Stuff' video by artist Misty Michelle that shows concept art and environments for the upcoming Sunstone Valley region of Free Realms. The article gives no mechanics, quests, prices or release details beyond saying more video about the region's new content would follow.

title: Double Station Cash Exclusive with GameStop and EBGames
summary: This is a German-language freerealms.com news post, captured from the site's Neuigkeiten (news) section, announcing that SOE Pre-Paid Cards bought at GameStop or EBGames would double the buyer's Station Cash if redeemed between September 14 and September 16, 2012. The text never mentions Free Realms by name, and it is a site-wide SOE promotion rather than game content, so it has no Free Realms facts for the rebuild.

title: Free Realms Launches Sunstone Valley Update
author: Martuk
summary: Official SOE announcement (posted from a press release) that the first area expansion update, the Sunstone Valley zone, went live on the day of posting. It lists the update's content categories: nearly 50 new quests, overworld Combat Areas, Boss Battles and Combat Encounters, 30 Blacksmithing recipes, and new housing, consumable and ride items. No individual quest names, rewards or prices are given.

title: Free Realms - What is New?
summary: A freerealms.com news post (captured 2012-09-24, posted "3 days, 19 hours ago", so the exact date is not stated) announcing fan site giveaways run by FR.Zam, Wikia, Mystic Mayhem and Free Realms Insider. The prizes include new items from Sunstone Valley and SC (Sony Cash) codes or cards, and the post directs entrants to each site's rules and Terms of Service.

title: Super Secret Stuff: Sunstone Valley Part 2 -- New Features!
summary: A short SOE news post announcing a video with development team member Ryan Shannon giving an 'insider look' at Sunstone Valley, described as a new adventure area for Free Realms. The page contains no written details about features, quests, or mechanics, and its posting date cannot be determined from the capture.

title: Free Realms - What is New?
summary: A short official news post (titled 'In The Works: Goal Time Screenshots') saying the Free Realms Community Team attended Dragon*Con in Atlanta, GA, where fans attended a special panel and were shown screenshots of the upcoming Goal Time update. The post gives no details of what Goal Time contains beyond its name. The client has a string 'Goal Time Soccer' (id 318), which may relate to this update but the article does not say so.

title: Free Realms - What is New?
summary: A short official SOE promotional post announcing Sunstone Valley as the newest area in Free Realms. It says the area offers new friends and foes, new rewards, and a Blacksmith gameplay element. The page gives no date beyond a relative 'Posted 5 days, 20 hours ago' and no details on quests or mechanics.

title: October Special: Get Your Own Walmart Shirt!
summary: A freerealms.com news post promoting a October promotion in which buying a $10 Station Cash card at Walmart and redeeming it during October earned a Walmart Shirt. It is a limited-time retail tie-in for the running game, and the page gives no item stats or quest details.

title: Free Realms - Player Studio
summary: A freerealms.com program page announcing Player Studio, where players design new in-game items using sample geometry, write a name, description and storyline rationale, and submit them. Selected items are sold in the SOE Marketplace priced in Station Cash, with revenue shared with the creator. The page gives no date, and the client text table has many 'Created by ... for Player Studio!' item descriptions, showing the program did ship items.

title: Free Realms - Player Studio FAQ
summary: This SOE FAQ page describes the Player Studio program, in which players design in-game items for sale in the SOE Marketplace and receive a share of sales. Free Realms is one of four SOE games listed as slated to kick off the program, with more details promised at SOE Live (October 18-21, 2012). The page describes a planned program and does not detail any Free Realms item, quest or mechanic.

title: Free Realms - Player Studio Get Started
summary: A Player Studio guide for submitting player-made house items to Free Realms. It sets the technical rules for geometry and textures: OBJ meshes, 32-bit TGA textures without alpha, one UV set, UVs within 0-1, a 1000-polygon cap, and a single combined mesh per item. The client contains item descriptions credited 'for Player Studio', which confirms the program existed in the game, though the page itself gives no date.

title: Free Realms - Guia de Estilo do Player Studio (Player Studio style guide)
summary: A Portuguese-language Player Studio style guide for user-made Free Realms items, covering art style, colour, silhouette, scale and material rules, plus file specs for shirt textures, poster textures and housing item models (polygon counts and texture sizes). It describes how community-submitted items were meant to be built for the game, and the page was captured in October 2012.

title: Free Realms - ¿Qué novedades hay?
summary: This Spanish-titled page is a German-language summary of the Free Realms update notes for a 1 September update (the year is not printed; the page's 'published 2 years, 2 months ago' relative to the 2012 capture suggests about 2010). It lists new marketplace pet and Wugachug housing content plus a festival set of vendor and decor items, but gives no details beyond names.

title: Free Realms - What is New? (German-language patch notes, "Aktualisierungsbemerkungen vom 24. Juni")
summary: A German-language Free Realms 'What is New?' page listing the highlights of a June 24 update: a new playground in Snowhill, the June membership package contents, and new housing, pet and coin-shop items. The page gives no year; the 'Posted 2 years, 4 months ago' note relative to the 2012 capture suggests 2010 but this is not stated. Item names are translated German and no English client names were confirmed for them.

title: Die Sever sind wieder verfügbar! (Free Realms - Quais são as Novidades?)
summary: A short SOE news post announcing that Free Realms servers are available again after downtime. It points players to Robbie's Tent in Greenwood (Grünwald) for current offerings and tells members to visit the royal vault. The page is mostly German with a Portuguese site frame, and it gives no specifics beyond these pointers.

title: Free Realms - Neuigkeiten: Aktualisierungsbemerkungen vom 15. Juli
summary: A German-language SOE patch-notes page (update of 15 July, year not stated on the page; relative age on capture suggests about 2010) listing two new daily activities, a combat-zone villain-count adjustment, and new items in the Coin Shop, housing, mounts and clothing categories. Item names are listed under category headings only, with no prices or stats given.

title: Free Realms - Quoi de neuf ? (Aktualisierungsbemerkungen vom 22. Juli)

It lists new pet monkeys sold in the Marketplace, a saber-tooth tiger mount, the return of the members' daily Cloud Jumps activity (Rio) that gives coins, new coin-shop housing items, and a fix letting players teleport into the Thornheart Palace without falling through the floor.

title: Free Realms - ¿Qué novedades hay? (German patch notes, "Aktualisierungsbemerkungen vom 13. August")
summary: A German-language SOE patch-notes summary (dated 13 August, year not shown on the page) listing the highlights of a Free Realms update: the Domo pet companion, Domo clothing, Domo housing blocks, and butterfly-themed housing items from the Coin shop. The page has no prices or levels, and the year must be inferred from context.

title: Free Realms - Quoi de neuf ?
summary: This German-language page (inside a French-titled freerealms.com news shell) lists the highlights of a Free Realms update dated 26 August, covering a beach-ball mount, mutual teleporters, a meadow housing plot, a coin shop, pet friends and members-only fairy characters. The page gives only short headline bullets with no prices, levels or detailed mechanics. The year is not stated; the only date clue is the relative 'published 2 years, 2 months ago' at capture time.

title: Free Realms - ¿Qué novedades hay?

The article gives no year; its relative timestamp ('Publicado desde hace 2 años, 1 mes') and the capture date suggest about September 2010, but this is an inference.

title: Spielt ab Herbst Free Realms auf eurem Mac!
summary: A short official SOE news item (page chrome in Spanish, body text in German) announcing that a Mac version of Free Realms was being developed by TransGaming and SOE for release in autumn. It states Mac players would share the same servers as PC players, with further details promised in the following weeks. The article gives no exact release date and the posting date is only a relative age ('hace 2 años, 3 semanas'), so the timing cannot be pinned down from this copy.

title: Free Realms - Jetzt auch auf Mac!
summary: A German-language SOE news post announcing that Free Realms became available on Macintosh computers. It says Mac and PC players share the same servers and that a character can be played from either platform. The post gives the minimum OS as OS X Leopard 10.5.8 and points to freerealms.com for download and setup guides.

title: Free Realms - Quoi de neuf ?
author: Harvey Burgess
summary: A French-language producer letter from Harvey Burgess, introducing himself as Free Realms' new producer. It apologises for late membership packs (June and July updates), promises the August pack early in the month and future packs early each month, and announces a Farm update with a new farm, farm items, a new seed, a boom box and other farming features, with Ranching teased as upcoming. The page gives only a relative date ('il y a 1 année, 3 mois'), so the exact publication date is unknown.

title: Free Realms - ¿Qué novedades hay?
summary: A freerealms.com news post (page in Spanish chrome, body in German) announcing that the Uncle-Sam summer items would leave the Marketplace, with a deadline of Wednesday 10 August 2011. It lists the Uncle-Sam outfit pieces and three colored sparklers, marked (SC), and tells players to buy them from the Marketplace before then. The page does not state the item prices.

title: Free Realms Celebrates 20 Million Registered Players!
summary: SOE announced that more than 20 million users had registered for Free Realms since its April 28, 2009 launch. To celebrate, a Letterman Jacket was given away to players who logged in and claimed it between October 21 and October 31, 2011, and the Community Team held dance parties in Sanctuary on October 21, 2011.

title: Spooktacular Continues and New Rides
summary: A Spanish-language freerealms.com news post announcing new Halloween Spooktacular items in a game update: a teaser for new rides, the October Member Pack contents, a new Bog Shore Lot with Halloween housing items, new Halloween outfits, and the return of past Halloween Coin Shop items. The page gives only a relative date ('hace 1 año, 1 semana'), so the exact date is unknown.

The page gives only a relative date ('11 months, 2 weeks ago'), so no exact release date can be recovered. The text is a Portuguese translation, so names are carried over from the client table.

The page gives only a relative date ('11 months, 2 weeks ago'), so no absolute publication date is recorded.

title: "SOE Child's Play"-Spendenaktion

Players buy Child's Play items, mainly the Snowflake unicorn mount, during December, and SOE donates $10 per item up to $50,000. The page gives a relative age ('10 months, 3 weeks ago') rather than an exact date.

The text never names Free Realms, and its list of participating games is empty, so it gives a rebuilder no Free Realms quest, item, price, event or mechanic data.

It also adds five new building textures and lists the houses and lots available for purchase or visiting. The post is undated; its capture-relative posting age is '2 months, 3 weeks ago'. Whether these features shipped as described is not stated.

title: Free Realms - Neuigkeiten
summary: A German-language freerealms.com news post announcing a housing UI overhaul and new features: a house options window, a free camera and hide options for flora and pets while decorating, five new building-block textures, and a list of houses and plots that players can browse in the Marketplace.
